Three compounding factors: (1) the PVC data-ledger-db-0 (200 Gi, reclaim policy Delete) is still actively mounted by the running, ready pod ledger-db-0 — the kubernetes.io/pvc-protection finalizer is holding intentionally because of this; removing the finalizer or scaling down the StatefulSet to let the deletion finish would permanently destroy the backing volume. (2) The most recent backup job (ledger-db-backup-29621280-h7kpd) failed with a fatal AccessDenied error on S3 upload — no backup artifact was written, so there is no confirmed recovery point. (3) Proceeding tonight before node patching under time pressure increases the risk further. A human engineer must confirm the PVC was genuinely intended for deletion (not accidentally included by the cleanup script), restore S3 write access and complete a verified backup first, and then decide whether to scale down the StatefulSet or remove the finalizer — steps that could cause irreversible data loss and are beyond what automated support should approve.
